open_points.subject: activation authorization boundary
open_points.text: `module:surface` ... admits the request: any agent composes and proves; the owner or any agent asks to activate, an agent only a `read` version (A16 rule 3, A06).
open_points.question: May every owner or agent token call the activate operation, with `module:flows` returning its own `refused` result when an agent names an effectful version, or must `module:surface` reject that call as `not_permitted`?
options: Every owner or agent may call activate; `module:flows` refuses an agent's effectful version.
`module:surface` permits agents to call activate only for read-only versions and rejects other activation calls as `not_permitted`.
open_points.default_guess: Every owner or agent may call activate, and `module:flows` returns the operation's own `refused` result for an agent's effectful version.
